title: Horizon and Rivergate
author: Theo Reyes
blurb: Tamsin Almeida, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent five years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
